title: Facebook & Instagram Marketing for Businesses in 2025
content:
Marketing in social networks - the complete guide for businesses that want to stay relevant

Marketing on Facebook and Instagram has become a necessary component of the strategy of every business in the digital age of 2025. The presence on these leading social networks, under the "Meta" umbrella, is no longer a recommendation - it is a must for growth, reaching new audiences and building a meaningful relationship with customers, and offers tremendous potential for businesses of all sizes.
But how do you do it right? How do "likes" and "followers" become paying and loyal customers? How do you navigate between the changing algorithms and passing trends? This guide is designed for exactly that: to dive deep and understand how to build a winning strategy for these platforms that will serve your business goals in the coming year and beyond.

Why is social marketing critical right now?

In 2025, social networks are much more than a place to share photos or promote posts. They have become showrooms, service lines, sales platforms and even social gathering places. The networks directly affect purchasing decisions, personal branding, and the success of campaigns of any kind.

An interesting fact: Over 60% of the users of the networks in Israel say that they were exposed to a new brand for the first time through a social network.

Why Facebook and Instagram?

The main benefits for businesses in 2025:

Despite the rise of new platforms, Facebook and Instagram still hold a huge market share and an active and diverse user base in Israel and around the world. Here are some reasons why they are so essential:

  1. Huge reach (Reach): Billions of active users worldwide, including millions in Israel, are on these platforms every day. This is an opportunity to reach a huge audience.
  2. Advanced segmentation capabilities (Targeting): Meta's advertising system allows you to target audiences with almost surgical precision based on demographics, interests, behaviors, geographic location, and more. This means that you can present your message to the people who are most likely to be interested in it.
  3. Visual platforms: Instagram by nature, and also Facebook to a large extent, are visual platforms that allow you to present your product or service in an attractive and fascinating way through photos, videos (especially releases!), and stories.
  4. Community building and involvement (Engagement): These are not just bulletin boards. You can create real interaction with the audience, answer questions, receive feedback and build a loyal community around your brand.
  5. Diverse business tools: From business profiles, through online stores (Shops) to advanced analysis tools (Insights), Meta offers a variety of dedicated tools for businesses.
  6. Combining campaigns: The ability to manage integrated campaigns on Facebook and Instagram from one place (Meta Business Suite) optimizes the advertising process.

Key trends for 2025

1. Authentic content is the new king

Surfers already recognize "sponsored posts" from a mile away. What really works is authentic, human content with real value - whether it's a mobile video, behind the scenes or a personal post from the heart.

2. Community before sale

Brands that establish an active community around them (through groups, interactive stories, live discussions) enjoy not only high engagement - but also customer loyalty.

3. Rhythm, rhythm, rhythm

The algorithms love frequent content. Posting once a week? It's not enough anymore. The recommended pace varies between platforms - but a minimum of 3-5 posts per week is the standard.

4. Influencers continue to rule - but in a small way

Micro-influencers (with 5,000–50,000 followers) are becoming more sought after than big celebrities. why? Because their audience is involved, real, and feels "close to home".

5. Artificial intelligence in the marketing service

AI is today integrated in content creation, audience analysis, and even in chatbots that manage 24/7 online customer service.

The main platforms for marketing in 2025

platformWhat should be published in it?A notable advantageWho is it for?
InstagramStrong visuals, stories, reelsEmotional connection through visual contentFashion, lifestyle, food brands
TikTokShort, creative, challenging video contentCrazy viral exposureBrands with a young audience
FacebookCommunities, groups, longer contentA mature and loyal audienceLocal businesses, professional services
LinkedInProfessional content, personal branding, articlesNetworking and business trustB2B, consultants, service providers
YouTubeLong videos, explanations, demonstrationsThe second largest search engine in the worldBusinesses with complex services or courses

6 steps to building a winning marketing strategy

Want to build a smart and professional presence on social networks?
The digital world is full of content - so it's important to know how to stand out, connect with your audience and plan a strategy that really works. Whether you are a small business, an international brand or a local service provider – proper content management can turn followers into customers.
So how do you do it right? Here are six simple but critical steps, and winning tips for curating content that will leave a mark.

First step: strong foundations - establishing winning business profiles

Before starting to run with campaigns, it is important to make sure that your base is solid:

  • Become a business profile: If you haven't done so yet, convert your Facebook and Instagram profiles to business profiles (Business Account/Page). This opens access to statistics, advertising options and contact buttons.
  • Optimizing the profile:
    • Profile picture and logo: Make sure your logo is clear and well displayed even at small sizes.
    • user name (Handle/Username): Choose a name that is catchy, easy to remember and the same (if possible) on both platforms and on your website.
    • Bio (Bio) / about: This is your "pitch". Clearly describe what the business does, what value it offers, and add a clear call to action (for example, a link to the website, to a landing page, to a sale). On Instagram, use the only link in the bio wisely (you can use tools like Linktree or create a dedicated landing page on the website).
    • Contact details: Fill in all the relevant contact information (phone, email, address if any).

Step two: Building a winning strategy (not just "posting")

This is where most businesses fail. Effective marketing requires a plan. Without a strategy, you just "throw content into the air" and hope for the best.

  1. Setting clear goals (SMART Goals): What do you want to achieve?
    • Brand exposure and awareness? (Brand Awareness)
    • Increasing traffic to the site? (Website Traffic)
    • generating leads? (Lead Generation)
    • Increasing direct sales? (Sales/Conversions)
    • Strengthening customer loyalty? (Customer Loyalty)
    • Community building? (Community Building)
    • Set specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound (SMART) goals. For example: "Increase the amount of leads from Facebook by 15% in the coming quarter."
  2. Knowing the target audience in depth: Who is your ideal customer?
    • demography: Age, gender, location, language, income level, education.
    • areas of interest: What are they interested in? What groups are they members of? Who are they following?
    • behaviors: Purchase habits, use of devices (mobile/desktop).
    • Pain points and needs: What problems does your product/service solve for them?
    • The better you understand your audience, the more accurately you can create content and advertisements that speak to them. Use Meta's Audience Insights tool.
  3. Content strategy development (Content Strategy): What will you publish, when and where?
    • Content pages (Content Pillars): Define 3-5 key topics that your content will cover, related to the business and the interests of the audience. for example, A digital agency can talk about marketing tips, client success stories, industry updates, a look at the "behind the scenes" of the agency.
    • Various formats: Don't just settle for pictures. Tinted with:
      • Short videos (Reels): The hottest format right now, especially on Instagram. Great for quick tips, demos, humor, trends.
      • Stories (Stories): For more authentic content, "behind the scenes", surveys, questions and answers, limited time promotions. Use the interactive stickers!
      • quality pictures: Products, staff, atmosphere.
      • Carousels (Carousels): Several photos/slides in one post. Excellent for short tutorials, showing processes, "before and after".
      • live broadcasts (Live): For direct interaction, questions and answers, launches.
      • User Content (UGC – User Generated Content): Share posts and photos of happy customers (with their permission). This is very reliable and social content.
      • Text and links: On Facebook, text posts or those that lead to articles on the site are still relevant.
    • table of contents (Content Calendar): Plan the posts in advance (at least a week or two ahead). This ensures consistency and enables strategic thinking. Set a realistic posting frequency for you. Consistency is more important than crazy amount.
    • Brand voice (Brand Voice): Define your tone and language - are you formal? friendly? funny? professional? Maintain consistency.

Step three: Creating content that magnetizes and causes engagement

Content is the king, but quality and relevant content is the emperor!

  • Winning visuals: Invest in quality photos and videos. You don't need expensive professional equipment, even a modern smartphone can be enough, but pay attention to lighting, composition and basic editing. Use tools like Canva to easily design posts and stories.
  • Tell a story (Storytelling): People connect to stories. Share the story of the business, the customers, the products.
  • Give real value: Don't just be a bulletin board. Provide tips, useful information, solve problems, answer common questions. When the audience sees you as a source of knowledge, trust and loyalty will increase.
  • Encourage interaction: Ask questions, create polls, ask followers to share their opinion or experiences, hold contests and activities that carry prizes.
  • Compatibility with the platform: What works well on Instagram (very visual, releases) will not necessarily work the same on Facebook (more space for text, groups, events). Adjust the content.
  • authenticity: People want to see the people behind the brand. Don't be afraid to show "behind the scenes", challenges and successes.
  • Use hashtags (#) wisely: On Instagram they are essential for reaching new audiences. Use a combination of popular, niche and unique hashtags for your brand. On Facebook they are less critical but can still help.

Fourth step: sponsored advertising (Meta Ads) - reach the right audience at the right time

Relying only on organic (unfunded) exposure is almost impossible in 2025. Sponsored advertising It is a mandatory tool for accelerating growth.

  • Why do you need sponsored advertising?? Reach new audiences who don't follow you, promote important posts, achieve specific goals (leads, sales), and compensate for the decrease in organic exposure.
  • The advertising system (Meta Ads Manager): This is your control center. Learn to use it effectively.
  • Choosing the purpose of the campaign: The system will guide you to choose a goal (awareness, traffic, engagement, leads, app promotion, sales). Choose the goal that matches your business goal for that campaign.
  • Audience segmentation (Targeting): This is where the real power lies.
    • core audiences (Core Audiences): Segmentation by demographics, interests, behaviors.
    • Custom audiences (Custom Audiences): Audiences based on your data - customer list, website visitors (requires pixel installation), people who have engaged with the page. These are "warmer" audiences.
    • similar audiences (Lookalike Audiences): Meta finds people who are similar in characteristics to your custom audiences. A great way to reach a new but relevant audience.
  • locations (Placements): Where the ads will be displayed (Facebook feed, Instagram feed, Stories, Releases, Messenger, Audience Network). You can choose automatic or manual.
  • Budget and bid strategy (Bidding): Set a daily or total campaign budget and choose how meta will use it to achieve the best results.
  • The ad creative: The ad itself should be attractive, clear, with a clear message and a strong call to action (CTA). A/B test different ads (images, video, texts, calls to action) to see what works best.
  • Landing pages: If the ad links to the website, make sure the landing page is relevant to the ad, optimized for mobile and easy to navigate.

Step five: Community management and interaction

It doesn't end with publishing the post or ad.

  • Respond quickly: Respond to comments and private messages quickly and courteously. It shows you care.
  • Encourage conversation: Respond to comments, ask follow-up questions, tag relevant people.
  • Handle negative feedback wisely: Do not delete (unless it is spam or offensive). Answer in a professional manner, offer to switch to a private conversation to solve the problem.
  • Listen to the audience: Pay attention to questions, complaints and compliments. It is a valuable source of information for product, service and marketing improvement.

Sixth step: measurement, analysis and optimization (what is not measured, is not managed)

  • Meta Business Suite Insights: Meta's built-in tool provides a lot of data on the performance of pages and posts: reach, engagement, clicks, video views, demographic data on the audience and more.
  • Ads Manager Reporting: Detailed data on the performance of the sponsored campaigns: cost per result (CPA, CPC, CPM), return on investment (ROAS), conversion rate.
  • Google Analytics: If you are directing traffic to the site, use Google Analytics (with UTM tags in the campaigns) to see what happens after the click - how long they stayed on the site, which pages they visited, and whether they completed a conversion.
  • what to measure? Focus on indicators (KPIs) that are relevant to the goals you have defined. If the goal is leads, measure the amount of leads and cost per lead. If the goal is awareness, measure exposure and engagement.
  • optimization: Use data to understand what works and what doesn't. What type of content gets the most engagement? Which ad brings the most conversions? Which audience responds best? Make changes and adjustments in strategy, content and campaigns accordingly.

Hot trends for Facebook and Instagram marketing in 2025

Social networks never stop developing - and the digital world of 2025 is already here. Algorithms change, audiences demand more authenticity, and brands need to think differently to stay relevant. So what are the most important trends that businesses need to know this year to succeed?

1. Authentic and personal content - more than ever

The audience already easily recognizes "fabricated" or overly marketing content. Surfers want to see the people behind the brand: employees, customers, processes, stories from real life. The most successful posts will be those that feel like a conversation between friends, and not like a polished advertisement.

How to apply?
Get out of the photo studio - take pictures of the everyday, share insights (even if they include learned mistakes), a peek behind the scenes, satisfied customers (with their approval!), or even less planned but human moments. Transparency in values ​​and challenges builds deep trust.

2. Short and catchy video (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) with immediate value

The dominance of the short formats continues, and the algorithms are pushing them hard. But it is not enough to be short - it has to capture interest from the first second and provide a clear value or a strong emotion. A 15-30 second video can generate more engagement than an entire ad - as long as it is executed correctly.

How to stand out?
Start with a strong "hook" - an intriguing question, a surprising result, a quick and useful tip. Use clear text on the screen, dynamic editing, relevant sound (but don't rely solely on it), and end with a clear call to action or point to think about.

3. AI in content creation - a smart tool, not a substitute for humanity

Chatbots, image generators, tools for writing posts - artificial intelligence is here to help, optimize and inspire, but not to replace human contact. Users recognize generic content created "on auto" and react less to it. The winning combination is between AI efficiency and human creativity and audience understanding.

What is recommended?
Use AI tools to get content ideas, create initial drafts, analyze data or even create basic visuals. But always Go through the content, adapt it to your brand voice, add unique insights, make sure it is accurate, relevant and speaks the language of your audience. The personal touch is the difference.

4. Community-based marketing - beyond involvement, to creating belonging

The most successful brands in 2025 don't just "speak to" their audience, they create an active and engaged community around them. Dedicated Facebook groups, Telegram or Discord channels, website forums - all of these become central arenas for building loyalty. Customers want to feel part of something, contribute and connect with similar people.

What can be done?
Build and nurture a community around your brand or area of ​​interest. Encourage discussions, give community members a platform to ask questions and help each other, share content exclusive to community members, and listen to the feedback that comes from there. A strong community is a tremendous marketing asset.

5. Targeted and authentic influencer marketing

The trend is moving from super-influencers with millions of followers, to collaborations with micro-influencers and niche influencers (with thousands to tens of thousands of followers). Most of them have a smaller audience, but it is very focused, loyal and engaged, and their recommendations are seen as more reliable.

How to apply?
These are influencers whose content and values ​​really fit your brand, and whose audience overlaps with your target audience. Build a transparent and clear collaboration, based on creating real value for followers and not just "pushing" a product. Measure success not only in exposure, but also in engagement and business results (like using a unique coupon code).

6. The Rise of Social Commerce

More and more platforms (especially Instagram and Facebook, but also TikTok and Pinterest) allow users to discover products and buy them without leaving the app. Turning the browsing experience into a smooth shopping experience is becoming more important.

What is recommended?
If you sell physical products, make sure you take advantage of the capabilities of Facebook and Instagram Shops. Tag products in posts and stories, use dynamic catalog ads, and ensure that the purchase process (whether on the platform or on the website you are directed to) will be easy and convenient, especially on mobile.

Important highlights for the application:

Beyond the specific trends, remember that success in social networks in 2025 rests on fundamental principles that do not change: Give real value to your audience (and not just promote yourself); Be humane and approachable - Authenticity brings closer and builds trust; Listen and respond quickly – Interaction is the key to building a community; andGive your customers a platform - User content (UGC), recommendations and success stories are extremely powerful and reliable marketing tools. Integrating these principles into your strategy will strengthen the influence of trends and bring you closer to results.

Advertise alone or use a digital agency?

Correct management of Facebook and Instagram requires time, knowledge, creativity and constant updating. Small businesses at the beginning of their journey can start on their own, while learning and experiencing. But as the business grows and the needs become more complex, or if you simply don't have the time or internal resources, cooperation with a professional digital agency like Adwrks 365 could be the solution. An agency brings experience, advanced tools, a team of experts and the ability to manage all aspects of your digital marketing in a strategic and data-based manner.

Summary: to succeed in social networks in 2025

Facebook and Instagram continue to be powerful arenas for growing your business in 2025, but as we've seen, mere presence is no longer enough. The digital world demands more: Defined strategy that guides every action, Authentic and quality content that really gives value and speaks to the audience, Building an active community based on a real relationship, andWise use of tools - From accurate sponsored advertising to constant data analysis for optimization.

Success does not happen in one day. It requires a deep understanding of the audience, adaptation to changing trends, experimentation, measurement and persistence. Applying the steps and principles we detailed in this guide will allow you to leverage the enormous power of social networks and turn them into a significant growth engine for your business.

title: Google Shopping Guide 2025: Essential Tool for E-commerce Sites
content:
Google Shopping - the essential tool for growing your sales site

Find out how to advertise your products on Google Shopping and use the tool to promote sales, leads and website traffic.

Online shopping - we all do it! And it is without a doubt the biggest thing in the last decade.

Online shopping has long been an integral part of our lives. If you have an online store, you surely aim to increase exposure, attract more potential customers and increase sales. One of the most effective ways to achieve this is through Google Shopping.

Sales shop owner? Want more exposure, more sales?
Promote your store and products in the most prominent position on Google

Promotion on Google Shopping is a tool duty for you!

Have you ever looked for a specific product and found yourself jumping between countless websites, comparing prices and features? The process can be exhausting. This is where services that centralize products from a variety of stores in one place come into play. While marketplace sites such as Amazon, eBay and others play an important role, Google Shopping offers a unique and central platform directly within the world's largest search engine.

Google Shopping allows potential buyers to discover, compare and buy products from a wide variety of sellers, all from the familiar Google search experience. For you, as a seller, this means tremendous exposure to a target audience that is actively looking for what you offer. Clicking on your product takes the buyer directly to your website to complete the purchase - making this platform a powerful engine for driving quality traffic and sales.

If you're not taking advantage of Google Shopping, you're probably missing out on a significant opportunity. This guide is designed to help you deeply understand the platform, its benefits and how you can start leveraging it for your business in 2025.

A shopping campaign is profitable for both buyers and sellers (advertisers) and is considered one of the most effective ways to advertise products on Google these days.

Google Shopping is:

Powerful: Google Shopping applies Google's search technology to help you find and research products from online stores around the web and then directs you directly to where you can buy them.
comprehensive: Find everything from common to unusual products.
fast: Almost immediately after entering a search, you'll see images of relevant products and links to more information, including the stores that sell them.

What is Google Shopping?

Google Shopping is a service from Google that allows consumers to search, compare and discover physical products offered for sale by retailers and sellers across the Internet. The service functions as a price comparison engine (CSE - Comparison Shopping Engine) and displays rich visual search results.

The history of the service begins in 2002 under the name "Froogle", which acted as a product index. In 2012, Google made a significant change and turned the service into a paid advertising model (Pay-Per-Click), where retailers have to pay for their products to appear in prominent positions. Today, Google Shopping is an integral part of the Google Ads advertising platform.

It is important to distinguish between two main components in Google Shopping:

  1. Shopping Ads: These are paid ads (PPC) that appear in prominent positions in Google's search results, in the dedicated "Shopping" tab, in Google Photos, on Google's partner sites, and sometimes also on YouTube, Discover and Gmail (mainly through Performance Max campaigns). The ads are activated and managed through the Google Ads account and are based on product data uploaded to Google Merchant Center.

  2. Free product cards (Free Listings): Google also allows an organic (free) display of products, mainly in the "Shopping" tab, but sometimes also in the main search results and in Google Images. To appear for free, a Google Merchant Center account and a valid product feed are still required, but there is no cost for clicks.

Unlike regular Google text ads that are based on targeting keywords that the advertiser chooses, Shopping ads (and the free tickets) rely on Product Feed. This feed contains detailed information about each product you sell (name, description, price, image, brand, availability, etc.). Google scans the feed and uses this information to automatically match the relevant products to the users' search queries.

Why should you use shopping ads on Google?

Most online shopping trips start with a Google search. A strong Google Shopping presence is critical to reaching potential customers at the exact moment they are looking for the products you offer. Here are some key reasons why this is a must-have tool:

  • Outstanding visual visibility: Shopping ads often appear at the top of the search results, above the text ads and organic results, or in a prominent position next to them. The visual format (image, price, familiar name) catches the eye and provides critical information at a glance, leading to higher click-through rates (CTR) compared to text ads for product queries.

  • Quality and targeted traffic: A user who clicks on a shopping ad has already seen the image of the product, its price and the name of the seller. Therefore, these clicks tend to be of higher quality, with a higher probability of leading to a purchase, because the user arrives at the product page with clear expectations.

  • Wider exposure: Your products can appear in a variety of locations on the Google Network (search, shopping, images, YouTube, partners, etc.), and in addition, multiple of your shopping ads or your shopping ad and text ad can appear together for the same search query, increasing your "real estate" on the results page.

  • Competitive advantage: If your competitors are using Google Shopping and you are not, you are losing significant market share. Presence on the platform allows you to compete directly and present your advantages (price, promotions, availability).

  • Data-based management and measurement: Google Ads provides detailed tools for tracking the performance of shopping ads, including impressions, clicks, costs, conversions and return on advertising spend (ROAS). This data enables constant optimization of the campaigns.

  • Free exposure: In addition to paid ads, the option to appear in free product cards provides an opportunity for additional exposure and traffic without direct advertising cost.

How do shopping ads look and where are they displayed?

As mentioned, shopping ads are visual in nature and usually contain:

  • Image of the product: The most prominent ingredient.

  • Product Name (Title): A brief description of the product.

  • price: Current product price.

  • Name of the seller/store: Your brand or store name.

  • Sometimes: Star ratings (from product reviews), special offers (like "free shipping" or "discount"), or local availability.

Main performance locations:

  1. Google's main search results page (google.com): Usually appear as a carousel of images at the top of the page, or in a separate column (usually on the right side on desktop computers). Can appear alongside text ads and organic results.

  2. "Shopping" tab (Shopping Tab): A dedicated tab within the Google search engine, which only displays product results (ads and free tickets) and allows for more advanced filtering and comparison.

  3. Google Images (Google Images): Relevant shopping ads can appear when users search for images related to products.

  4. Partner sites in the Google search network: If you selected this option in the campaign settings, ads can also appear on other sites that use the Google search engine.

  5. YouTube, Discover, Gmail: Mainly through automated smart campaigns like Performance Max, Google can present your products on these platforms to relevant audiences.

It's important to note that both paid ads and free tickets can appear at the same time, with the paid ads usually getting more prominent placements.

How does Google Shopping work? The mechanism behind the scenes

To understand how to succeed in Google Shopping, it is important to know the two main technological components that drive it:

  1. Google Merchant Center (GMC): This is your central "control panel" for everything related to your product data on Google. Here you upload and manage your store and product information, set shipping and tax information, and monitor data integrity. A GMC account is a necessary condition for activating shopping ads and appearing in free tickets.

  2. Product data feed (Product Feed): This is a file (usually in XML, TXT format or through Google Sheets or API) that contains a detailed list of all the products you want to advertise on Google. Each line in the file represents a product, and each column represents an "Attribute" of the product. Google uses the information in the feed to create the shopping ads and match them to the search queries.

Essential product features in the feed

In order for your products to be approved and displayed properly, the feed must include several mandatory properties, and it is highly recommended to also include as many optional properties as possible to improve performance. Key features include:

  • ID: A unique identifier for each product.

  • Title: The name of the product to be displayed in the ad (critical for optimization).

  • Description: A more detailed description of the product (used by Google to match queries).

  • Link: URL of the product page on your website.

  • Link to the image (Image Link): URL of the main product image (quality image required).

  • Price: The current and accurate product price.

  • Availability: Stock status (in stock, out of stock, pre-order).

  • Brand: The brand name of the product.

  • GTIN (Global Trade Item Number): Global Commercial Item Number (such as EAN, UPC, ISBN). Mandatory for most new products from well-known brands.

  • MPN (Manufacturer Part Number): Manufacturer's catalog number (important if there is no GTIN).

  • Google Product Category: Product classification according to Google's taxonomy (improves relevance).

  • Product Type: Classification of the product according to the categories on your website (helps to organize campaigns).

Matching process: After uploading the feed to GMC and linking the account to Google Ads, Google scans the product data. When a user performs a relevant search, Google's algorithms compare the search terms to the information in the feed (mainly titles, descriptions, categories, brand, etc.) and decide which products to display in the shopping ads. The ad auction takes into account your bid and the quality of the ad and landing page (quality score) to determine ad placement.

How to set up the Google Shopping campaign

The process for activating shopping ads includes several main steps:

  1. Opening and setting up a Google Merchant Center account:

    • Go to the Google Merchant Center website and sign up with your Google Account.

    • Fill in your business details (name, address, phone).

    • Verify your URL (using HTML code, Google Analytics, Tag Manager or Google Domains).

    • Set the shipping details (costs, regions, delivery times).

    • Set the tax details (if applicable).

  2. Creating and uploading the product feed:

    • Choose a method to create the feed:

      • manually: Creating a file (for example, in Google Sheets) and uploading it. Suitable for a small number of products.

      • Plugins/Apps: Popular eCommerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, etc.) offer dedicated plugins or apps to automatically create and sync the feed with GMC. This is the recommended method for most stores.

      • Scheduled Fetch: Google can "pull" the feed regularly from a URL where it is updated.

      • Content API: An advanced solution for developers that allows product data to be updated in real time.

    • Make sure the feed meets Google's requirements: Include all mandatory features and as many recommended features as possible. Make sure the data is accurate and up-to-date (especially price and availability).

    • Upload the feed to GMC and follow the approval of the products: After uploading, Google will check the feed. You can see the status of the products (approved, rejected, pending) in the "Diagnostics" tab in GMC. It is important to correct errors as soon as possible.

  3. Linking a Google Merchant Center account to a Google Ads account:

    • Within the GMC account, navigate to Settings -> Linked Accounts.

    • Select Google Ads and enter the Customer ID of your Google Ads account.

    • Confirm the request within your Google Ads account.

  4. Creating a shopping campaign in Google Ads:

    • In your Google Ads account, click "+" to create a new campaign.

    • Select a goal for the campaign (eg, "Sales").

    • Choose a campaign type:

      • Shopping (Standard Shopping): Gives you more manual control over bids, product groups and negative keywords. Recommended for beginners or those who want individual control.

      • Maximum performance (Performance Max - PMax): Automated goal-based campaign that uses machine learning to show your products (and other ads) across all Google networks (including Shopping, Search, Display, YouTube, Discover, Gmail). Google is pushing hard towards PMax, and it can be very effective, but requires trust in automation and provides less direct manual control. As of 2025, PMax is the dominant type and recommended by Google for many advertisers.

    • Select the linked Merchant Center account and the country where the products are sold.

    • Define the bidding strategy (Bidding Strategy - for example, maximizing clicks, target return on advertising expenses - Target ROAS) and the daily budget.

    • Set additional targeting (specific geographic locations, if required).

    • Organize the products in ad groups (Ad Groups) or asset groups (Asset Groups in PMax) by category, brand, or any other logic that will allow effective management and optimization.

    • Save and run the campaign.

Optimizing Google Shopping campaigns for maximum success in 2025

Setting up the campaign is just the beginning. Getting the most out of your Google Shopping investment requires constant optimization. Here are some of the key areas to focus on:

  1. Optimization of the product feed (Feed Optimization): This is the most important factor for success! A quality and accurate feed is the basis for everything.

    • Titles: Include relevant keywords that customers might search for in the product title (eg, "Adidas Ultraboost Men's Running Shoes Size 43 Black"). Organize the important information first.

    • Descriptions: Write detailed descriptions rich in relevant keywords.

    • Images: Use high-quality, clear images on a white background (usually) that best showcase the product. Consider adding additional images (additional_image_link).

    • Google Product Category: Choose the most accurate category from Google's taxonomy.

    • Unique identifiers (GTIN/MPN): Make sure they are accurate and correct. This is essential for proper matching and features like price comparison.

    • Price and availability: Always keep this data up to date to avoid product rejection or poor user experience.

    • Additional features: Fill in as many relevant characteristics as possible (color, size, material, gender, etc.) to enable better filtering and increase relevance.

    • Structured data (Structured Data): Implement a product schema (Schema.org Product markup) on the product pages of your website to allow Google to verify the feed data (especially price and availability) and enable automatic updates.

  2. Campaign Structure:

    • Standard campaigns: Split campaigns by product categories, brands, profit margins or historical performance to enable differential budget allocation and bidding. Use Product Groups to divide inventory within a campaign and set different bids.

    • Performance Max: Provide Google with as many quality "signals" as possible - relevant audiences (customer data, interests), asset groups targeted by product categories, and a well-organized product feed.

  3. Bidding Strategies:

    • Experiment with different strategies. Start with "Maximize Clicks" to collect data, then move on to conversion-based strategies like "Target ROAS" or "Maximize Conversion Value" once you have enough conversion data.

    • Use bid adjustments in standard campaigns for devices, locations, times of day and audiences to focus budget on the most profitable locations. In PMax, the automation takes care of this, but it is important to provide the correct data (accurate conversion values).

  4. Negative Keywords: (mainly relevant for standard campaigns)

    • Regularly go through the Search Terms Report and identify irrelevant queries that triggered your ads. Add them as negative keywords to avoid wasting budget on low-quality clicks. You can also add negative lists at the account level. (In PMax, control is more limited, but you can request conditional exclusions from Google Support or use brand safety settings).

  5. Utilization of plugins and promotions:

    • Promotions: Use the Merchant Promotions program in GMC to display special discounts or offers (like "10% off", "free shipping") directly in your shopping ads. This can significantly increase the CTR.

    • Product Ratings: If you have reviews of your products (via approved third-party services), allow them to be featured as stars in ads. This builds trust and increases CTR.

    • Seller Ratings: Your overall store rating (based on reviews collected by Google and its partners) can also appear and reinforce credibility.

  6. Performance monitoring and analysis:

    • Closely track key metrics (KPIs) in Google Ads: impressions, clicks, CTR, cost per click (CPC), conversion rate (CPA), conversion value (Conversion Value), and return on advertising spend (ROAS).

    • Use the various reports: search term report, location report, device report, product report (Product report - shows performance at the individual product level).

    • Regularly check the "Diagnostics" tab in the GMC to identify and fix feed problems or policy violations.

Don't forget the free product cards!

Even if you have a limited advertising budget or you are just starting out, it is very important to enable the option of free product cards (Free Listings) in Google Merchant Center. It requires the same feed used for paid ads.

The advantages:

  • Additional exposure at no cost: Your products can appear in the "Shopping" tab, in Google Photos, in Google Lens and in the main search (in some modules) without you paying for clicks.

  • Organic traffic to the site: Another way to attract potential buyers to your website.

  • Complementary to paid ads: Can appear alongside or in place of your ads, increasing your overall chance of landing a customer.

To enable this, make sure that in your GMC account, under "Growth" -> "Manage Programs", the "Free product listings" program is enabled.

Trends and innovations in Google Shopping for 2025 and beyond

[Image: Conceptual illustration of AI and Machine Learning driving a shopping campaign]

The world of digital advertising is dynamic, and Google Shopping continues to evolve. Here are some trends to watch out for:

  • Dominance of automation and AI: Performance Max campaigns are the prominent example. Google is investing heavily in machine learning to automatically optimize bids, targeting and ad creation. This means that the quality of the data you provide (in the feed, in the audiences) becomes even more critical to the success of the campaigns.

  • A richer visual experience: Google is constantly exploring new and more interactive formats for displaying products, including increased use of video and "lifestyle" images.

  • Omnichannel shopping: A stronger connection between the online experience and the physical experience. Local Inventory Ads allow buyers to see which products are available in a store near them, with the option of self-collection (Click & Collect).

  • Sustainability and transparency: Google allows advertisers to highlight sustainability features of products in the feed, such as recycled materials or environmental certifications. Consumers are increasingly looking for responsible brands.

  • Focus on first-party data: With increasing restrictions on third-party cookies, collecting and properly using your customer data (via customer lists, for example) becomes essential for effective targeting and optimization.

Summary: Why Google Shopping is still the king of eCommerce in 2025

Google Shopping is no longer just a "nice option" - it is an essential component in the marketing strategy of any eCommerce business that wants to grow and succeed. title: Remarketing — What It Is, How It Works, and Why It Matters
content:
Remarketing Guide (Remarketing - Remarketing)

Remarketing - Remarketing, also known as remarketing, is a smart strategy used by business owners to return to surfers who have already visited their site. It is an advertising tool that allows you to remind visitors of the products or services they were interested in, thus motivating them to come back and make a purchase.

In this article, we will explain in a simple and clear way what remarketing is, why it is essential to the success of your business, and what steps can be taken to leverage it effectively through platforms such as Google and social networks. With these techniques, you can increase your website's conversion rate and gain higher visibility among your potential audience.

What is remarketing?

Remarketing is an advertising strategy that allows you to display targeted ads to users who have visited your website or used your application. The technology is based on "cookies" - small tracking files that identify specific users and allow advertisers to show them customized ads on other websites, on social networks like Facebook and Instagram, and on search engines like Google.

For example, if someone visited your site and saw a certain product, but didn't complete a purchase, you could show them an ad that reminds them of that product or offers them a discount, hoping to get them to come back to the site and complete the purchase.

Why is remarketing important?

The main benefit of remarketing is the ability to reach a targeted audience that has already shown interest in your business, increasing the chance of converting them into customers. Here are some main reasons why you should integrate remarketing into your marketing strategy:

      1. increasing conversions: Most surfers tend to leave the site without making a purchase or leaving details. Remarketing allows you to remind them of what they were interested in and get them to come back and take the action.

      2. Strengthening the brand: Repeated exposure to your ads on social networks, search engines or other websites strengthens your brand awareness. The more visitors are exposed to your brand, the more likely they will remember it and treat it as a trusted and familiar source.

      3. Advanced segmentation: Remarketing allows you to segment your audience according to their behavior on the site. For example, you can show ads to those who visited a certain product page, to those who added products to the cart but did not complete a purchase, or to those who viewed certain content and did not continue.

Want to consult a remarketing expert?

Click here for a free, no-obligation consultation

How does remarketing work?

When surfers visit your website, their browser receives a cookie, which is a small piece of information that is saved on the user's device and is used to track their actions on the Internet. These cookies allow advertisers to identify the surfers and examine their behavior on your site, such as pages they visited, products they viewed, or actions that were not completed, such as a purchase or subscription to a newsletter.

With the help of tools like Google Ads and Facebook Pixel, you can collect important data about your website visitors. A Facebook Pixel, for example, is a code that is inserted into your website and allows you to track the actions of users after visiting the website, which helps to tailor ads to users according to their behavior.

As soon as the users leave your website, the system recognizes the users with the help of the cookies and allows them to display personalized ads in other places around the Internet. Whether it is advertising on Google, Facebook, or other platforms, this process helps you bring back the surfers and increase the chance that they will return to your site and perform the desired action, such as a purchase or leaving details.

In this way, remarketing not only helps focus your marketing efforts, but also creates an improved user experience, as the ads you show are more relevant to people who have already shown interest in your products or services.

Let our experts work for you

Free campaign testing and consultation without obligation

Google remarketing campaign

Google offers an advanced tool for remarketing through Google Ads, which provides diverse and accurate capabilities for business owners who wish to convert visitors into customers. The tool allows ads to be displayed on the search network and on Google's display network (Display Network). The media network includes millions of websites, apps and YouTube, which gives Business exposure especially wide. Google collects information about users who have visited your website, and uses this data to show them personalized ads when they browse other websites or perform searches on the Google search engine.

Advantages of using Google for remarketing:

  1. wide spread: Google displays your ads on many sites that make up the Google Display Network. This means that once someone leaves your site, there is a high chance that they will come across your ads on other sites, which helps increase exposure to your brand and strengthen awareness of your products or services.

  2. A variety of formats: Google allows you to choose from a variety of different ad formats, including text ads, image ads, and video ads. The possibility of using a variety of formats allows you to attract the attention of customers in a way that suits your type of business, and to create ads that speak the visual language of your target audience.

  3. precise timing: Using Google Ads, you can control when to display the ads according to the behavior of the users on your website. This timing allows you to focus the message at the most relevant time, for example, if a user left the site after viewing a certain product, you can show him an ad exactly about that product the next time he surfs the Internet. This way you can increase the chance that they will return to the site and make a purchase.

In general, remarketing through Google Ads is a powerful tool that helps businesses maintain their presence in the eyes of customers, focus marketing efforts and significantly improve conversion rates.

Remarketing in social networks

Social networks such as Facebook and Instagram provide powerful remarketing tools that allow businesses to reconnect with users who have visited their website. With the help of Facebook Pixel, it is possible to track the surfers on your website and identify their behavior. Thus, as soon as the surfers leave the site, you can show them targeted ads while they surf Facebook or Instagram, thus increasing the chance that they will return to make a purchase.

Advantages of using social networks for remarketing:

  1. A wide and targeted audience: Facebook and Instagram have billions of active users, so you can reach a huge audience that is on these platforms every day. The ability to reach people by interests, age, geographic location and more allows you to target ads to specific groups of users who may be interested in your products or services.

  2. Various formats: The platforms allow you to display ads in a variety of formats, including image ads, video ads, carousel ads that show several products at the same time, and even story ads (Story Ads). This variety allows you to capture users' attention in creative and engaging ways, customized to your audience type.

  3. High personalization: One of the most prominent advantages of remarketing in social networks is the ability to match the ads exactly to the actions that the users have performed on your website. For example, if a user browsed a certain product but didn't complete the purchase, you could show them an ad highlighting that product, or a special offer to encourage them to come back. This creates a personalized user experience that increases the chance of conversions.

In general, remarketing in social networks is an effective tool that helps businesses maintain their presence in the eyes of users, strengthen the brand and improve the conversion rate by renewing the relationship with potential customers.

Types of audiences for remarketing

There are a number of primary audiences you should focus your remarketing efforts on. Knowing these audiences will help you tailor your messages and maximize the results of your campaigns:

  1. visitors to the site: People who visited your site but did not take any further action. They already know your brand, so it's easier to bring them back for another visit.

  2. Shopping cart abandonment: Users who added products to the cart but did not complete the purchase of the products. This audience has a high potential for conversions, as they have already shown interest in your products.

  3. Viewing certain products: Users who were interested in a specific product and did not proceed with the purchase. Through remarketing, you can show them ads that remind them of this product, or offer them a special offer.

  4. mailing lists: Users who signed up for your newsletter but didn't become customers. They've already shown interest in your information, so it's important to keep reaching out to them with relevant offers.

  5. Past customers: People who have already made a purchase in the past, but have not returned to make another purchase. This audience can be targeted with personalized offers, such as similar products or discounts on future purchases.

Strategies for a successful remarketing campaign

To maximize the effectiveness of remarketing, here are some important tips to consider:

  1. Adjusting the messages: It is important to adjust the ads according to the behavior of the website users. For example, if a user added a product to their cart but did not purchase, you can show them an ad with an immediate purchase offer, such as a discount or free shipping, to encourage them to complete the purchase.

  2. Additional value proposition: Offer a benefit or discount to surfers who returned to the site through remarketing. This could include a discount code, an exclusive offer or a gift with purchase, which may encourage them to make a purchase.

  3. Measuring results and continuous improvement: It is important to monitor the performance of your campaigns and improve them. See which ads work best, which audiences are more responsive, and optimize accordingly. Use data analytics tools to understand user behavior and make continuous improvements.

title: What Is AEO? Will It Replace SEO?
content:
AEO vs. SEO: Will answer engines replace traditional search?

The field of search engine optimization (AEO) has been gaining popularity in recent years, causing many to wonder: What is an AEO?? Is this the end of the road for traditional SEO? Will answer engines make traditional search engines obsolete?
The short answer is – not. Although AEO is a significant development in the digital world, it does not replace traditional SEO. In fact, AEO offers a significant boost to SEO strategies, and improves user experience and visibility in search results.
In this article, we'll look at the differences between AEO and SEO, how they fit together, and how you can upgrade your digital marketing strategy to get the most out of both tools.

What is an AEO? How is it different from SEO?

AEO, or Answer Engine Optimization, is a new approach to search engines that focuses on providing direct and accurate answers to users' questions. Unlike traditional search engines that direct you to different websites and pages that contain information, AEO offers a direct and focused answer within the search results, usually in the form of a featured snippet. The goal is to provide the most accurate answer to the question, without the user having to go to additional websites. For example, if you search for a question like "What is the AEO?", the search engine can display a direct answer that summarizes the information from your website.

On the other hand, SEO (search engine optimization) focuses on improving the ways of accessing websites, so that the search engines know how to present your website in the search results based on criteria such as keyword relevance, content quality, external links and more.

Will AEO replace SEO?

Although AEO (Search Engine Optimization) is gaining popularity and becoming an important trend in digital marketing, it is not expected to replace traditional SEO. Instead, AEO joins as an additional element designed to enhance and complement existing SEO strategies. Search engines still rely on traditional factors such as content quality, site structure and external links to determine rankings. AEO works alongside this, while improving the user experience and optimizing content in a way that directly answers the surfer's questions, thus being able to appear more in immediate answers and featured content sections. AEO and SEO work together to increase digital visibility and provide an optimal user experience.

How do AEO and SEO fit together?

The understanding that AEO and SEO do not replace each other, but are combined together, allows you to get the most out of both tools and achieve optimal results. In fact, the two work in a complementary way and include the following reasons:

  1. SEO remains the foundation – Search engines still rely on traditional SEO factors, such as keywords, site structure and link quality, to determine rankings.

  2. AEO upgrades SEO - AEO bases itself on the foundation of SEO and promotes the content to appear more prominently in the search results, including displaying direct answers to the surfer's questions.

  3. Improving the user experience - AEO provides direct answers, which increases the user experience and reduces the rate of leaving the page (Bounce Rate), thereby also contributing to the website's visibility in search engines.

  4. Collaboration to improve visibility – AEO and SEO work together to improve a website's overall visibility, with SEO ensuring that content appears in search results, and AEO helping it stand out and be more available in narrow search data.

Through a perfect combination of AEO and SEO, you can maximize digital results and achieve higher exposure, improvement in search results and increased conversions.

The user experience is faster and more convenient, and as a result the site may produce positive benefits in SEO, such as increasing the time spent on the site and reducing the bounce rate.

Combined visibility and more opportunities

SEO Guarantees that your site will appear in search results, but AEO Ensures that your content takes up space in the featured sections and gives you the opportunity to be seen more prominently. The featured sections are a very important place to gain additional attention and can lead to more organic traffic.

Optimized for a variety of searches

While SEO focuses on understanding keywords and searching texts, AEO Focuses on understanding users' intent and providing accurate answers. AEO optimization can be an additional boost to marketing keywords and website promotion in a more targeted way.

2. Organizing the content clearly

Use subheadings, lists, and tables to help surfers find the answers they want quickly. Any small change in structure can lead to a place in the featured section.

3. Optimization for voice searches

Also, growing use of voice assistants like Google Assistant and Siri requires adapting your content toVoice searches. You must ensure that your answers are clear, direct and use natural language in question.

4. Use of structured data

use theSchema Markup To help search engines better understand your content and increase the chance of appearing in featured sections or rich results.

5. Optimization for immediate answers

One of the most effective methods to appear in AEO results is to create content focused on providing immediate answers. This can be done by presenting information in a simple and understandable way, such as tables, lists or summaries.

In conclusion: AEO and SEO - the winning combination

In this article we explained about What is an AEO?, how it integrates with SEO and how the two work together to improve your digital visibility. While SEO remains critical and unchanging, AEO offers an additional advantage by presenting more direct and targeted answers. With the right combination of the two, you can upgrade website visibility, increase user engagement, and optimize your digital strategy so you're ready to face the challenges of the future.

The platforms for building websites

Sponsored advertising on Facebook (and Instagram)

Sponsored advertising on Facebook and Instagram has become one of the most powerful and effective digital marketing tools for businesses of all sizes. With advanced options for precise targeting of target audiences and the ability to fully control the budget, any business can advertise in a smart way and see immediate results. But, to utilize these tools effectively, it is important to understand the system in depth. In this article we will present everything you need to know about sponsored advertising on Facebook, how to reach the right customers, how to plan an accurate budget and what are the methods to succeed with sponsored campaigns.

 

What is sponsored advertising on Facebook?

Advertising on Facebook allows businesses to display sponsored ads to users on the platform, according to various personal characteristics such as interests, geographic location, internet behavior and more. The system gives a lot of control over the target audience and the types of ads displayed, which makes it possible Advertise for businesses In a more targeted and effective way compared to traditional advertising channels, such as television, radio, billboards and print media.

traditional advertising channels They are the ones that were used before the advent of the Internet and social networks. for example:

  • TV and radio: Marketing messages that are broadcast to the masses, but do not allow segmenting the audience according to interests, exact location or consumer behavior. This creates a broad but less focused exposure.
  • Billboards: Physical ads in public places that reach everyone passing through the area, without the ability to adapt the message to the needs and preferences of specific audiences.
  • printed press: Ads in newspapers or magazines that reach subscribers or buyers, but it is not possible to measure the effectiveness or adapt the message to the changing needs of diverse audiences.

In each of these channels, the exposure is broad but not focused, and it is more difficult to track and measure the effectiveness of the campaign accurately.

On the other hand, on Facebook it is possible to segment the audience down to the most personal level, adjust the messages according to the exact interests of the users, and measure each interaction with the ads in real time, which leads to much higher effectiveness and improved return on investment (ROI).

The benefits of advertising on Facebook and Instagram

    • Advanced targeting: The main tool that differentiates Facebook is targeting. Target audiences can be defined according to demographic data (age, gender, location), interests (sports, food, technology), behavior (previous purchases, website visits) and more.

    • Budget flexibility: Facebook is suitable for all types of budgets, and you can start advertising even with a small budget, while having full control over daily and periodic expenses. Furthermore, speed adjustments can be made based on performance.

    • Measuring results in real time: The tools offered by Facebook for managing campaigns allow you to see the results in real time, optimize, and improve the campaign on the fly. It is possible to know how many leads, sales or exposures the campaign has generated.

    • Integration with Instagram: If you have a business aimed at a younger audience, advertising on Instagram is a particularly powerful tool, offering the same targeting options as Facebook, but with a more modern and visual design suitable for the platform.

How to reach the right customers?

The first step to success in advertising on Facebook is to know how to correctly define your target audience. The success of the campaign largely depends on the correct targeting. Here are the main tools that will help you:

1. Custom Audiences

This is one of the most powerful tools on Facebook. It allows you to upload existing customer data (such as emails or phone numbers) and create campaigns that target them directly. In addition, you can create an audience based on a certain behavior on your website - such as people who visited a certain page on the website or who performed a certain action (adding a product to the cart, watching a video, etc.).

2. Lookalike Audiences

If you already have a customer base or loyal audience, this tool can be used to find new users similar to them in terms of interests, age, consumer behavior and more. This way, you can expand your exposure to new users who will most likely be interested in your products or services.

3. Targeting by interests and behaviors

Facebook allows you to target your ads to people who are interested in specific areas related to your brand, such as sports, food, technology or art. Beyond that, you can also target according to behaviors - such as online shopping, searches on certain topics, or interactions with relevant content.

4. Geographic targeting

This tool allows you to advertise according to the physical location of the target audience - countries, cities, or even a certain radius around a certain address. If your business provides a local service, this is a critical tool for targeting the relevant customers.

Defining the goal will help you determine an accurate budget and invest in ads that will produce the desired result.

2. Do A/B Testing

To understand what works best, it's important to perform A/B tests on different ad types, different target audiences or different creatives. This way you can focus your budget on the ads that produce the best performance, and avoid wasting money on ads that don't bring results.

In addition, we will detail about Website construction price list, we will offer useful tips, and present our services, including a calculator to estimate the cost of building a website.

Common site types

    • Image sites (One Page Site): This site presents the main information about the business on one central page. It is designed to concisely present your services and products and sometimes includes convenient scrolling to display all content in one place.
    • Image sites with several pages: Websites consisting of several pages (about 5 main pages), for example: home page, about page, services, contact us and sometimes also gallery, blog or articles.

    • Store websites (E-commerce): Complex websites that allow you to sell products online, including a product catalog, a shopping cart, and a secure purchase process.

    • Professional content sites: Sites that include rich content such as articles, blogs, videos and galleries. These sites are designed to provide a lot of information and drive higher engagement with the surfers.

Main website building platforms

In building websites today, there are a variety of platforms designed to provide different solutions according to the needs of the users. Each platform offers different advantages and is suitable for different types of websites. Here is an overview of the main platforms on the market:

  1. WordPress: One of the most popular platforms for building websites, WordPress offers great flexibility and a wide variety of plugins and design templates. It is suitable for personal websites, blogs, image websites, and even e-commerce websites. WordPress' content management system (CMS) is easy to use and allows for extensive customization, making it an ideal platform for businesses of all sizes.

  2. Wix: A platform with a very friendly user interface that allows you to build websites very easily. Wix offers modern design templates and a drag-and-drop system that allows you to create websites without the need for code. This is an excellent solution for users who do not want to go into the technical depth of building websites.

  3. Shopify: A leading platform for building e-commerce websites. Shopify focuses on supporting online sales and provides advanced tools for managing online stores, including integration with payment systems, inventory management, and financial reports.

  4. Joomla: Another CMS platform, which is between WordPress and Drupal in terms of complexity and capabilities. Joomla is suitable for sites with more complex requirements such as forum sites, member sites and sites with a complex content structure. It provides great flexibility and advanced content management.

At Adwrks 365 we specialize in building websites based on a platform WordPress. WordPress allows us to create customized, flexible and user-friendly websites, with the ability to add many plugins and make various adjustments according to the specific needs of your business. If you are looking for a powerful and professional solution to build your website, WordPress is the ideal choice for that.

Domain and web hosting

    • Domain: The domain is the unique address of your website on the Internet. If you have an existing domain, it can be connected to your new website. If you don't have a domain, we can help you purchase a custom domain.

    • Website hosting (Hosting): Website hosting service includes storing web pages, files and other content on servers. Every website needs a storage service in order to be accessible online. we offer Storage services High quality and reliable, guaranteeing high accessibility and good performance.

Website security (SSL)

Website security is an essential part of building and maintaining any website. One of the most important means of ensuring website security is installing an SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) certificate. An SSL certificate ensures that the information transmitted between the user and the website server is encrypted and protected, which prevents unauthorized access and sensitive information such as passwords and credit card details.

Maintenance and support services

The website hosting is the service that allows the website to be accessible on the Internet, while ongoing maintenance includes updates, upgrades and repairs as needed. These services ensure that the website will function optimally and will be updated over time.

Infrastructure for organic promotion (SEO)

The site will be built with an infrastructure that supports organic promotion (SEO), which enables the adjustment of the pages to the search engines to improve the position of the site in Google. Additional SEO services are not included in the basic price and can be ordered separately.

before starting build a website, you should pay attention to several important points:

  1. Setting goals: Determine what the purpose of your website is—is it to increase sales, improve image, or provide information?

content:
SEO Guide for Beginners: 6 Essential Steps

מהו קידום אתרים ולמה הוא חשוב?

קידום אתרים (המוכר גם כקידום אורגני או SEO – Search Engine Optimization) הוא תהליך שמטרתו לשפר את דירוג האתר שלך בתוצאות החיפוש של מנועי החיפוש, כמו גוגל.

סדרת הפעולות שנעשות כוללת אופטימיזציה של הדפים באתר כדי להבטיח שהאתר שלך יופיע במקום גבוה יותר בתוצאות החיפוש עבור מילות מפתח רלוונטיות.

בכך, ניתן להגדיל את כמות הצפיות והמבקרים באתר.

קידום אתרים כולל שני סוגים עיקריים של אסטרטגיות: קידום אורגני (SEO – Search Engine Optimization) : קידום אורגני מתמקד בשיפור הדירוג של האתר שלך במנועי החיפוש בצורה טבעית ואורגנית, ללא תשלום ישיר.

המטרה היא להבטיח שהאתר שלך יופיע במיקומים גבוהים בתוצאות החיפוש עבור מילות מפתח רלוונטיות, מה שמוביל ליותר תנועה אורגנית לאתר שלך.

כדי להשיג את המטרה הזו, SEO כולל מגוון פעולות ותחומים: אופטימיזציה של התוכן : יצירת תוכן איכותי ומעניין שמותאם למילות המפתח החשובות, תוך שמירה על קריאות ונגישות גבוהה לקוראים ולמנועי החיפוש.

קישורים פנימיים וחיצוניים : בניית קישורים פנימיים בתוך האתר שלך שמסייעים להנחות את הגולשים ולחלק את הסמכות בין דפי האתר, ובנוסף יצירת קישורים חיצוניים מאתרים אחרים שמצביעים על האתר שלך, מה שיכול לשפר את סמכותו בעיני מנועי החיפוש.

מהירות האתר : שיפור מהירות הטעינה של האתר כדי לספק חווית משתמש טובה יותר ולמנוע ממשתמשים לנטוש את האתר עקב טעינה איטית, מה שיכול להשפיע על הדירוגים שלך במנועי החיפוש.

באמצעות שיפוט נכון של המרכיבים הללו, קידום אורגני מאפשר לאתר שלך לעלות בדירוגים בתוצאות החיפוש בצורה טבעית ולמשוך מבקרים איכותיים מבלי להוציא כספים על פרסום ממומן.

קידום ממומן (PPC – Pay Per Click) : פרסום בתשלום שמוביל למודעות שמופיעות בראש תוצאות החיפוש או באתרים אחרים, בתמורה לתשלום על כל קליק על המודעה.

קידום ממומן לא רק מביא לתנועה מיידית ואיכותית לאתר שלך, אלא גם יכול לתרום באופן עקיף לקידום האורגני שלך.

content:
What Is Internet Marketing / Digital Marketing?

שיווק באינטרנט, הידוע גם כשיווק דיגיטלי או שיווק ברשת, הוא תחום רחב ומתפתח המנצל את האינטרנט וכל אמצעי התקשורת הדיגיטלית לקידום עסקים, מוצרים ושירותים.

עם התפתחות הטכנולוגיה והאינטרנט, השיווק הדיגיטלי הפך להיות אחד הכלים המרכזיים לכל עסק המעוניין להצליח ולהתרחב בשוק הדינמי של היום.

שיווק ופרסום באינטרנט בשנת 2024, השיווק הדיגיטלי לעסקים כולל מגוון רחב של טכניקות וערוצים שמאפשרים להגיע ללקוחות פוטנציאליים בצורה מדויקת ויעילה.

מהקידום האורגני של אתרים ועד לפרסום ממומן, השיווק באינטרנט מציע כלים וטכניקות שמתאימים לצרכים שונים של עסקים.

צריך ייעוץ מותאם אישית?

אנחנו כאן בשבילך!

צור קשר לייעוץ חינם ללא התחייבות שיווק דיגיטלי לעסקים יתרונות של שיווק דיגיטלי לעסקים העולם הדיגיטלי משנה את הדרך בה עסקים מתקשרים עם הלקוחות שלהם.

חלק מהיתרונות המרכזיים של השיווק הדיגיטלי כוללים: הגעה ממוקדת: פרסום דיגיטלי מאפשר למקד את המאמצים בקהלים ספציפיים, על פי גיל, מיקום גאוגרפי, תחומי עניין ועוד.

תוצאות מדידות: כל פעולה שנעשית באינטרנט, החל מהקלקות ועד לרכישות, ניתנת למדידה ולעקיבה, מה שמאפשר לבעלי עסקים למדוד את החזר ההשקעה (ROI) ולבצע אופטימיזציה לפי הצורך.

עלות נמוכה: בהשוואה לפרסום המסורתי, השיווק הדיגיטלי לרוב מציע עלויות נמוכות יותר עם פוטנציאל לתוצאות גבוהות.

יכולת התאמה אישית: ניתן ליצור קמפיינים מותאמים אישית שיתאימו לצרכים ולהעדפות של כל לקוח פוטנציאלי, מה שמגביר את הסיכוי להצלחה.

גישה 24/7: אתרים ורשתות חברתיות פועלים סביב השעון, מה שמאפשר לעסקים להיות נגישים ללקוחות בכל עת.

title: Free Business Advertising: 7 Simple Self-Promotion Methods
content:
Free Business Advertising: 7 Simple Self-Promotion Methods

פרסום עצמי בחינם: האם זה אפשרי?

בעולם הפרסום והקידום הדיגיטלי, נדרש לרוב תקציב משמעותי כדי להגיע לתוצאות הרצויות.

אך האם אפשר לקדם עסק באינטרנט ללא עלות?

התשובה היא כן!

פרסום עסק חינם הוא אפשרי בהחלט, גם בעולם הדיגיטלי התחרותי של היום.

האינטרנט פתח עולם של אפשרויות עבור עסקים, גדולים וקטנים כאחד.

אחת מהאפשרויות המרתקות ביותר היא היכולת לקדם את העסק שלך בחינם.

אמנם, קידום בתשלום יכול להאיץ את התהליכים, אך קידום אורגני (חינמי) יכול להביא תוצאות מצויינות בטווח הארוך אם נעשה נכון.

עם תכנון נכון והשקעה של זמן, יצירתיות וידע, ניתן לפרסם את העסק שלך מבלי להוציא כסף.

במאמר זה, נציג 7 שיטות יעילות לקידום עסק באינטרנט בחינם, ונרחיב עליהן בהמשך: הקמת אתר בחינם: בניית נוכחות מקוונת משלך באמצעות פלטפורמות כמו וורדפרס או Wix.

content:
SEM vs PPC: What's the Difference?

בעולם השיווק הדיגיטלי, ההבדל בין SEM ל-PPC הוא נושא חשוב שנתקלים בו לעיתים קרובות, ולעיתים נוטים לבלבל בין המונחים.

מושגים כמו SEM (שיווק במנועי חיפוש) ו-PPC (תשלום לפי קליק) עולים לעיתים קרובות.

מאמר זה יבחן את ההבדל בין SEM ל-PPC ויבהיר את הקווים המנחים שבין שני המונחים.

על אף שהם קשורים זה בזה ומשתמשים זה בזה במסגרת אסטרטגיות שיווק דיגיטליות, ישנם הבדלים משמעותיים בין השניים.

מה זה SEM?

SEM, או שיווק במנועי חיפוש (Search Engine Marketing), הוא גישה רחבה לשיווק שמטרתה לקדם אתרים בעמודי התוצאות של מנועי החיפוש (SERP).

SEM כולל את כל האסטרטגיות הקשורות לשיפור הנראות של אתר במנועי החיפוש, בין אם מדובר בקידום ממומן ובין אם מדובר בקידום אורגני (SEO).

במסגרת SEM נכללות פעולות שונות, כמו קידום אורגני (SEO), קמפיינים ממומנים (PPC), ואופטימיזציה של מבנה האתר והתוכן שבו.

המטרה של SEM היא להגדיל את הנראות של האתר במנועי החיפוש ולהוביל לתנועה רלוונטית לאתר.

מה זה PPC?

PPC, או תשלום לפי קליק (Pay-Per-Click), הוא אחת מהאסטרטגיות השיווקיות הנכללות תחת המטריה של SEM.

יועץ שיווק באינטרנט יעזור לכם לבצע את הפעולות הבאות: הגדרת מטרות: יועץ יעזור לכם להגדיר את מטרות השיווק שלכם ולבנות אסטרטגיה שתסייע לכם להשיג אותן.

מחקר שוק: יועץ יבצע מחקר שוק כדי להבין את קהל היעד שלכם ואת המתחרים שלכם.

פיתוח תוכנית עבודה: יועץ יפתח תוכנית עבודה מפורטת שתכלול את כל הפעולות הנדרשות להשגת מטרות השיווק שלכם.

ביצוע הפעולות: יועץ יבצע את הפעולות הנדרשות, או ינחה אתכם כיצד לבצע אותן.

ניתוח נתונים: יועץ ינתח את נתוני הקמפיינים שלכם כדי להבין מה עובד ומה לא, ויבצע התאמות בהתאם.

יש לך שאלה?

content:
The Importance of a Digital Advertising Agency

בעולם המהיר והממוקד בדיגיטל של היום, תפקידם של משרדי פרסום דיגיטליים הפך יותר ויותר חיוני לעסקים המבקשים לבסס נוכחות מקוונת חזקה ולהתחבר לקהל היעד שלהם.

סוכנויות אלו מתמחות ביצירה וביצוע של אסטרטגיות שיווק דיגיטליות מקיפות הממנפות פלטפורמות מקוונות שונות להשגת מגוון יעדים, מהגברת המודעות למותג ועד לקידום מכירות.

במאמר זה, נחקור את ההיבטים והיתרונות העיקריים של סוכנויות פרסום דיגיטליות.

מומחיות והתמחות משרדי פרסום דיגיטליים מאוישים באנשי מקצוע מומחים בהיבטים שונים של שיווק מקוון.

מאופטימיזציה למנועי חיפוש (SEO) לניהול מדיה חברתית ופרסום בתשלום לפי קליק (PPC), סוכנויות אלו מביאות שפע של ידע מיוחד לשולחן.

מומחיות זו מאפשרת לעסקים לנצל את הטרנדים והטכנולוגיות העדכניות ביותר, ולהבטיח שמאמצי השיווק הדיגיטלי שלהם יעילים ועדכניים.

אסטרטגיות מותאמות אישית אחד היתרונות המרכזיים בעבודה עם משרד פרסום דיגיטלי הוא היכולת ליצור אסטרטגיות שיווק מותאמות.

סוכנויות מנתחות את המטרות הייחודיות של העסק, קהל היעד והתעשייה כדי לפתח אסטרטגיה המתאימה לצרכים הספציפיים שלהם.

גישה מותאמת אישית זו יכולה לשפר משמעותית את סיכויי ההצלחה בנוף הדיגיטלי התחרותי.

יעילות מחיר משרדי פרסום דיגיטליים מספקים לרוב פתרון חסכוני לעסקים בהשוואה לבניית צוות שיווק פנימי.

עסקים יכולים לחסוך בעלויות גיוס, הכשרה ותשתית על ידי מיקור חוץ של מאמצי השיווק הדיגיטלי שלהם.

בנוסף, סוכנויות יצרו קשרים עם פלטפורמות פרסום דיגיטליות, מה שמאפשר להן לנהל משא ומתן על תעריפים טובים יותר ולמקסם את ההחזר על ההשקעה (ROI) עבור לקוחותיהן.

ממדיה חברתית ועד אופטימיזציה למנועי חיפוש, יש אינספור דרכים להתחבר ללקוחות פוטנציאליים באינטרנט.

עם זאת, הצלחה בעולם השיווק הדיגיטלי יכולה להיות לא פשוטה, במיוחד עבור מי שחדש במשחק, ובדיוק כאן נכנסת לתמונה סוכנות שיווק דיגיטלית.

על ידי עבודה עם צוות מומחים המתמחה בקופירייטינג, יצירת תוכן רלוונטי ומעניין, קידום אתרים, ניהול קמפיינים ממוקדים, עסקים יכולים למקסם את הנוכחות שלהם באינטרנט ולהגיע לקהל רחב יותר.

במאמר זה, נחקור כיצד סוכנות שיווק דיגיטלית יכולה לעזור לך לקדם את העסק באינטרנט ולקחת אותו לשלב הבא, נספק לך טיפים למציאת הסוכנות המתאימה ביותר לעסק שלך.

בין אם אתה עסק קטן או חברה גדולה, השקעה בשיווק דיגיטלי היא מהלך חכם עבור כל עסק שרוצה לצמוח ולהצליח בשוק התחרותי של היום.

אילו שירותים מציעות סוכנויות שיווק דיגיטלי?

סוכנויות שיווק דיגיטלי מציעות מגוון רחב של שירותים שנועדו לעזור לעסקים לשפר את הנוכחות שלהם באינטרנט.

שירותים אלו יכולים לכלול הכל, החל מעיצוב ופיתוח אתרים ועד לניהול מדיה חברתית ושיווק בדוא"ל.

אחד השירותים הפופולריים ביותר שמציעות סוכנויות שיווק דיגיטלי הוא אופטימיזציה למנועי חיפוש (SEO).

קידום אתרים הוא תהליך של אופטימיזציה של אתר אינטרנט כך שהוא ידורג גבוה יותר בדפי התוצאות של מנועי החיפוש (SERP).

ניתן לעשות זאת על ידי יצירת תוכן באיכות גבוהה, אופטימיזציה של מילות מפתח ובניית קישורים נכנסים.

Digital Advertising Office — Internet Business Marketing

מהו משרד פרסום דיגיטלי ואיך משווקים כיום עסקים באינטרנט ?

אם בעבר עסקים היו מפרסמים בעיתון, ברדיו או מסתמכים על שמועות מפה לאוזן, כיום הדרך היעילה ביותר לשווק עסקים היא דרך האינטרנט.

עסקים קטנים וגדולים כאחד נשענים על פרסום ברשתות החברתיות, באתרי חדשות, במנועי חיפוש, באתרים ייעודיים ועוד.

במאמר הבא נסרוק את התחום ונראה כיצד כדאי לכם לקדם את העסק שלכם.

היכן אפשר לקדם את העסק שלי באינטרנט?

נראה שכל האינטרנט פרוס לפנינו, אבל יש מספר אתרים שהוכיחו שהחשיפה בהם היא רבה יותר.

לדוגמא, פייסבוק, אינסטגרם, טוויטר ואפילו טיק-טוק (שמיועד לעסקים שרוצים לפנות לקהל צעיר יותר) הן רשתות חברתיות פופולריות ביותר שאליהן רשומים מאות מיליוני בני אדם ברחבי העולם.

גם בארץ מרבים להשתמש בהן, ולכן שיווק נכון שמותאם לעסק ולפלטפורמת הרשת החברתית יכול להוביל לקידום עסקים וצמיחה כלכלית.

קיימים משרדי פרסום רבים שמתמחים ברשתות החברתיות, שיודעים איך לנסח פוסטים ממומנים שמושכים אליהם לקוחות ואיך "לטרגט" את המודעות לפי קהלים שונים בהתאם לעסק ולצרכיו.

פלטפורמה נוספת היא ענקית הטכנולוגיה גוגל, בעזרת קידום אורגני בגוגל, או בשם המקצועי שלו – קידום SEO – אפשר להגיע לאנשים שהחיפושים שלהם מתאימים בנושא שלהם לעסק שלכם.

בנוסף, קידום SEO מאפשר לפרסם מודעות באתרים שהאלגוריתם של גוגל לומד שקשורים לתחום העיסוק שלכם.

קידום אורגני בגוגל גורם למודעות להיטמע בצורה טבעית במנוע החיפוש ובאתר ולכן מייצר אצל הלקוח הפוטנציאלי תחושה נינוחה.
